name: Okami College
description: Okami College is a classic editorial WordPress theme for a hotel management college with its own teaching hotel. An inset photo window with a white tagline box and a teal-to-slate caption strip opens the home page, followed by staggered pick-up tiles, a results-first graduate case wall, ruled term rows, tracked-title cards with a banner strip, a parallax teaching-hotel band, partial-width pale panels with poke-out thumbnails, a price table and a navy offer band. Fraunces for headings and Source Serif 4 for reading. Sample content in English.
